parameters_generator module¶

Parameters generator. Generates a text file with the commands to insert in the job manager. Call with python3 parameters.generator.py parameter_to_explore min_parameter max_parameter step_size

parameters_generator.generate_parameters(filename, filename_prefix, parameter_to_explore, min_parameter, max_parameter, step_size)[source]¶

Creates a textfile containing commands for the job manager with a parameter to explore

Parameters:
  • filename (string) – Name of the file to register the commands and parameters
  • filename_prefix (string) – e.g. : “/opt/anaconda3/bin/python3 flocking_confluent_marchetti.py”
  • parameter_to_explore (string) – The parameter to vary, e.g. “point_number”, “boxsize”, “K_P”…
  • min_parameter (int, float) – Start value for the exploration
  • max_parameter (int, float) – End value for the exploration
  • step_size (int, float) – Increment size for the exploration
Returns:
Return type:

Nothing
parameters_generator.write_parameters_file(filename, filename_prefix, parameter_string)[source]¶

Concatenates a command prefix and the string of parameters to build a full command

Parameters:
  • filename (string) – Name of the file to write/append to
  • filename_prefix (string) – e.g. flocking_confluent_marchetti.py
  • parameter_string (string) – String of parameter to run the main script in the “Passed arguments mode”
Returns:
Return type:

Nothing
